verdict.rationale: Better Stack's first-party docs describe escalation policies that define who is alerted and in what order, continuing until the incident is acknowledged. The on-call guide shows a delayed fallback step: the on-call person is paged first, and after an unacknowledged interval (e.g., 3 minutes) the page goes to the whole team. Marketing pages add complex escalation rules based on time, team availability and incident origin. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repeat/loop rounds, detail on configuring multi-step delays per step, independent or hands-on corroboration.
